finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified on a fresh page load.

**Final report**

1. **DONE** — Provisioned dashboard `Service health` (at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, breadcrumb "Bench / Service Health") has 3 panels, titles exactly as shown: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**.

2. **DONE** — New dashboard **fwgr75-n1 Bench Dashboard** exists and is saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled **fwgr75-n1 Availability**; verified in the panel editor that the visualization picker reads "Stat" and the query editor's data source is **TestData** (default scenario returned live data).

3. **DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **fwgr75-n1 Notes** with content `## fwgr75-n1 Notes\n\nBench run fwgr75-n1 — created via automation.` (runid present, rendered on the dashboard). Saved.

4. **DONE** — Dashboard tag is **bench** (verified as a tag chip in Settings > General after saving), and the time range is **Last 6 hours** (`from=now-6h&to=now`). The save drawer's "Update default time range" checkbox was explicitly ticked before saving, so the range is persisted in the saved dashboard — confirmed by reloading at a URL without time params and seeing "Last 6 hours" restored.

5. **DONE** — Auto-refresh interval is **1m**. Set via the top-bar refresh picker and persisted by saving with the "Update default refresh value" checkbox ticked; after a fresh reload the top bar shows 1m and Grafana re-added `refresh=1m` to the URL from the saved default.

6. **DONE** — URL read from the browser page: **http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffzaca5v1ukg0a/fwgr75-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m** — dashboard UID **ffzaca5v1ukg0a**.

Final verification pass (fresh load, no modifications) confirmed: dashboard title "fwgr75-n1 Bench Dashboard", panels "fwgr75-n1 Notes" and "fwgr75-n1 Availability", Stat viz + TestData source, tag "bench", refresh 1m, range "Last 6 hours".
